summary: Banco Santander filed a 6-K reporting completion of a capital reduction via cancellation of 150,595,100 own shares, about 1.03% of share capital, reducing capital by EUR 75,297,550; the public deed was registered with the Commercial Registry of Santander on November 11, 2026, after an executive committee decision on November 4. Post-reduction capital is EUR 7,202,943,850.50 across 14,405,887,701 shares at EUR 0.50 nominal. Since November 2021, eleven buyback programs have retired 3,264,600,039 shares, roughly 18.8% of then-outstanding stock. Watch execution cadence of future buybacks.
